connectorUiConfig.title: FullHunt Typosquatting
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The [FullHunt](https://fullhunt.io) Typosquatting data connector ingests typosquatting domain candidates that imitate your monitored domains from the [FullHunt Enterprise API](https://docs.fullhunt.io) into Microsoft Sentinel. Requires the FullHunt **Dark Web Monitoring** module; without it the FullHunt API returns HTTP 403. The data connector is built on the Microsoft Sentinel Codeless Connector Framework.

sampleQueries.description: Latest FullHunt Typosquatting records (deduplicated by RecordId)
sampleQueries.query:
FullHuntTyposquatting_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by RecordId
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 10

sampleQueries.description: Typosquatting domains first seen in the last 7 days
sampleQueries.query:
FullHuntTyposquatting_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by RecordId
| project TimeGenerated, DomainName, LastSeen

dataTypes.name: FullHuntTyposquatting_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
FullHuntTyposquatting_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and Write permissions are required.

customs.name: FullHunt Enterprise API key
customs.description: A FullHunt Enterprise account and its API key are required, with the Dark Web Monitoring module enabled. See the [FullHunt authentication documentation](https://docs.fullhunt.io/authentication).

instructionSteps.title: Connect FullHunt Typosquatting to Microsoft Sentinel
instructionSteps.description: Copy your API key from your [FullHunt profile settings](https://fullhunt.io/user/settings/), then enter it below and select **Connect**. The connector polls FullHunt every 15 minutes.
